decisions.because: Requirement (AGENTS.md: a parser of bytes the node does not control gets a Kani proof): SecureEnvelope::decode reads every frame of any connection before authentication but lived in orchestrator, outside the proofs. Its framing moved to common::wire; wire::proofs prove it, calibrated by proof-task.py with three faults.

statement: A frame is a v2 envelope only if it starts with SKM and a version this node speaks; decoding any frame returns, and an accepted frame's header, payload and signature account for every byte, the payload exactly as long as its header says; what the node writes splits back into the same header, payload and signature (Kani: common::wire, frames up to HEADER_LEN + 6 bytes).
